answer.exemplar: Heat and humidity speed spoilage, so weather notes guide storage and ordering decisions.

questions.explanation: Heat and humidity affect spoilage. Weather notes guide storage and ordering choices.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a two-stage excuse for tact
questions.stem: Stage one: read the excuse. Stage two: judge if it is tactful and clear.

options.text: I have a prior engagement and cannot attend.
I hate these events; count me out.
Maybe, whatever, I do not care.
I am busy, do not ask details.

questions.explanation: A tactful excuse is clear and respectful. Option A states a conflict politely; others are rude, vague, or evasive.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Choose question about onboarding

stimulus.body: The interview is wrapping up. You want to know how new staff are trained. Pick the best question.

questions.stem: Which question best asks about onboarding?

options.text: How are new staff trained and supported?
Do I get free food?
Is the kitchen clean?
Can I skip training?

questions.explanation: Onboarding questions target training and support. Option A asks that; others target perks or avoidance.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.topic: Title forms when introducing a colleague
questions.learningObjective: Explain why matching title to role matters
questions.stem: Why should an introduced title match the colleague's actual role?

answer.exemplar: Matching title to role prevents confusion and shows honesty, helping guests trust the introduction.

questions.explanation: Matching title to role avoids confusion and shows honesty. Guests then trust the introduction.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Select description for a collaborative colleague
questions.stem: Which description fits a colleague who shares ideas and helps the team?

options.text: He is selfish and hoards ideas.
He is collaborative and generous.
He is careless and sloppy.
He is quiet and withdrawn.

questions.explanation: Sharing ideas and helping shows collaboration. Option B matches; others contradict or misread.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate a two-stage location answer
questions.stem: Stage one: locate the item. Stage two: verify against the sheet map.

options.text: The mixer is beside the oven.
The mixer is inside the oven.
The mixer is above the oven.
The mixer is gone.

questions.explanation: Beside means next to, not inside or above. Option A states the relation; others distort.

questions.subject: CHINESE
questions.learningObjective: Select phrase for a hot, dry afternoon
questions.stem: Which phrase describes a hot, dry afternoon for outdoor prep?

options.text: It is cool and rainy today.
It is hot and dry this afternoon.
It is freezing and snowy.
It is humid and sticky.

questions.explanation: Hot and dry matches the condition. Option B fits; others are opposite or misread.
